title: 第8章
slug: 澶墠鍎垮瓙鍤ｅ紶濡堝挭
content_zh: 第一章 酒吧相遇“阿迅！”欧慕瑄问身边的助理，“知道这件白色的礼服出自哪位设计师之手么？”这段视频是助理拿过来的，再呈给他们的总裁看之前，里面的哪件衣服是哪位设计师设计的，助理阿迅早已熟记在心！于是，英俊而干练的助理看了一眼屏幕回答，“是星空大师的作品。”“星空？！”又是那个女人？！欧慕瑄将视频倒回去一点，然后让画面定格在那件衣服上，她，的确很有才华，而他，对她的兴趣也越来越浓。“是，星空大师是时装界最年轻的多纳奖获得者，在顶尖女装行业享有的声誉很高。”多纳奖，时装界的奥斯卡奖，每年三年举办一次，奖励一位最优秀，最有实力和潜力的设计师，而星空是在去年力压一众候选人，夺得了此项殊荣。“是么？”微薄的唇斜出一抹完美而优雅的弧度，看来他是小瞧她了，“有星空的资料么？”“有！”阿迅立刻回到自己的办公室，将厚厚的一份文件交给欧慕瑄。自从欧慕瑄与星空在机场相遇，然后绯闻闹得沸沸扬扬开始，阿迅就开始收集星空的资料了，他知道这位天才设计师，很快就会引起他们向来淡漠的欧总的注意。资料里只有她的大学，去没有她去法国之前的事情，只说是华裔，很明显，是有人故意在遮掩，而除了这些，资料里还有她获得的奖，甚至还有她设计过的衣服的效果图。一件件衣服，或华丽，或优雅，或简约，但都有一个特点，自信和自立，就像她的人，明明身形看起来娇小柔弱，体内却像是蕴藏着无尽的力量，让人想要去一一挖掘，去开采！文件的最后一张，是当红影星顾佳泞的照片，她身上穿着一件酒红色的礼服，让原本气质甜美的她，立刻变得如同浴火的凤凰，光彩夺目。欧慕瑄重新翻了一遍，发现里面很多设计都是顾佳泞在做模特，再想起昨天叶芊沫提的条件，欧慕瑄的唇角泛起了一抹嗜血的笑意。“阿迅，去把我们公关部，传媒部，新闻部，企宣部的负责人都叫过来。”“是！”叶芊沫，我说过会让你来求我的。欧慕瑄关掉屏幕的同时，身边一直开着的电脑上，突然出现了一堆凌乱的字符，很明显，自己的电脑有人在恶意的攻击。于是，欧慕瑄立刻快速的输入一串指令，然而电脑只有片刻的安静，几乎是在两秒钟后，便又出现了之前的情况。居然有人敢入侵他的电脑？欧慕瑄燃起了斗志，打算跟对方战斗到底！这种情况，叶芊沫完全不懂，只看到电脑上涌出一排又一排诡异的字符，而小奶娃挥动着胖乎乎的小手，在里面输入一串又一串的指令。这种技术，作为电脑小白的叶芊沫完全不懂，不过看儿子看到儿子的脸，叶芊沫有些呆愣。琥珀色的眸子里满是冰冷的笑意，唇角斜起的淡淡笑意带着嗜血的味道，残忍而决绝，似乎铁了心要将对手置于死地！在外貌上，小奶娃除了琥珀色的眸子，五官与欧慕瑄并不相似，但此刻的神态却是……诡异的一致！一个小时的激战过后，小奶娃的唇角微微放松，胜利的微笑已经越来越明显。而办公室内，欧慕瑄挫败地仰靠在椅背上，他是电脑高手，从来没遇到过敌手，但是现在，却输给了这个入侵者。看着电脑上显示出的红心泡泡，以及一首老掉牙的《爱的初体验》，欧慕瑄感到了从未有过的挫败感。而这时，另一位助理顾新走进来汇报情况，刚一进门就看到他们向来冷酷的欧总仰在椅背上，听着这首“如果说你要离开我，请把我的照片还给我，我还要还给我妈妈……”顿时，助理被惊呆了，他们一向淡漠无情的总裁居然在听歌？而且还是……还是这么老土的歌？“……总……总裁……”顾新眨着一双清亮无辜的眼睛，“您……好……好兴致啊！”欧慕瑄抬起头，一记冰冷的眼神恶狠狠地瞪过去，随手扯掉了电脑的电源，“有事说事！”“是这样的，总裁，您之前设计的那套无坚不摧的网络安全防御系统在五分钟之前被人攻破了！”顾新说得很无辜。“什么？！”难道又是那个人做的？“查到是谁了么？”“目前……还没有……”“地址呢？对方的地址你们该查得到吧？”“报告总裁，上面一共显示了九千九百九十九个IP，几乎涵盖了世界的各个角落，我们……无能为力！”这么强大的黑客，他们还是第一次遇到啊。欧慕瑄很是无奈地挥挥手，“尽快修复漏洞。”“是！”看着这台电脑，欧慕瑄发誓一定要将这个人揪出来，不过，当务之急，还是要赶紧拯救电脑里面的文件要紧。重新打开电脑，里面的文件一个没少，只是电脑上多了一个他从没见过的软件，似乎是聊天软件，而桌面上有一个文档，打开，里面有一句话。“欧先生，我没有恶意，只是手痒，这个聊天软件是我们联系的纽带，不要删除哦。”欧慕瑄将鼠标移到到那个软件上，手迟疑了一下，没有删，如果能联系那最好，迟早他会查出对方是谁的！小奶娃完胜，一脸得意地看着叶芊沫，扬起小脸，等待着妈咪的奖励！叶芊沫很配合地在儿子脸上狠狠地亲一下，然后很是勤奋地帮小奶娃捏着肩膀，“儿子，你就不怕国家网络安全局的人来敲咱们家的门吗？”“妈咪，你觉得儿子会笨到留下自己家的地址让人家查吗？”也是，如果那些人能查到的话，早就来找他们麻烦了，于是叶芊沫很狗腿地抱着自己的儿子，“宝贝，既然你这么厉害，下次入侵瑞士银行，我要的不多，给你妈咪随意转个百八十亿美元就行，怎么样？”小奶娃囧，妈咪，你这是想让国际警察来敲咱们家门的节奏吧？
content_en: Chapter 1 Encounter at the bar "Axun!" Ou Muchuan asked the assistant next to him, "Do you know which designer this white dress was made by?" The assistant brought this video over and showed it to their president. Assistant Axun had already memorized which dress in it was designed by which designer! So, the handsome and capable assistant glanced at the screen and replied, "It's the work of Master Starry Sky." "Starry Sky?!" Is it that woman again? ! Ou Muxuan rewinds the video a little, and then freezes the picture on that dress. She is indeed very talented, and he is becoming more and more interested in her. "Yes, Master Xingkong is the youngest winner of the Donat Award in the fashion industry, and enjoys a high reputation in the top women's clothing industry." The Donat Award, the Oscar Award in the fashion industry, is held every three years to reward the best, most powerful and potential designer. Xingkong won this honor last year after overcoming many candidates. "Really?" A perfect and elegant curve appeared on his thin lips. It seemed that he underestimated her, "Do you have any information on Xingkong?" "Yes!" Axun immediately returned to his office and handed a thick document to Ou Muchuan. Ever since Ou Muxuan and Xingkong met at the airport and the scandal started to spread, Axun began to collect information about Xingkong. He knew that this talented designer would soon attract the attention of their usually indifferent Mr. Ou. The information only contains her university information, and nothing about what happened before she went to France. It only says that she is of Chinese descent. It is obvious that someone is deliberately covering it up. In addition to these, the information also contains the awards she has won and even renderings of the clothes she has designed. Each piece of clothing may be gorgeous, elegant, or simple, but they all have one characteristic, confidence and self-reliance. Just like her person, she may look petite and weak, but her body seems to contain endless power, making people want to dig and mine them one by one! The last picture in the file was a photo of the popular movie star Gu Jiali. She was wearing a burgundy dress, which made her sweet temperament immediately become as dazzling as a phoenix bathed in fire. Ou Muxuan flipped through it again and found that many of the designs were modeled by Gu Jiani. Thinking of the conditions Ye Qianmo proposed yesterday, a bloodthirsty smile appeared on the corners of Ou Muxuan's lips. "Axun, go and call the heads of our public relations department, media department, news department, and corporate propaganda department." "Yes!" Ye Qianmo, I said I would let you beg me. When Ou Muxuan turned off the screen, a bunch of messy characters suddenly appeared on the computer next to him. It was obvious that someone was maliciously attacking his computer. As a result, Ou Muchuan immediately entered a series of instructions quickly, but the computer was only quiet for a moment. Almost two seconds later, the previous situation appeared again. How dare someone hack into his computer? Ou Muchuan ignited his fighting spirit and planned to fight the opponent to the end! Ye Qianmo didn't understand this situation at all. She only saw rows and rows of weird characters pouring out of the computer, while the little baby girl waved her chubby little hands and entered string after string of instructions. As a computer novice, Ye Qianmo didn't understand this kind of technology at all, but when she saw her son's face, Ye Qianmo was a little stunned. The amber eyes were filled with a cold smile, and the faint smile tilted at the corners of his lips was bloodthirsty, cruel and decisive, as if he was determined to put his opponent to death! In appearance, except for the amber eyes, the facial features of the little baby are not similar to Ou Muchuan, but the expression at this moment is... strangely the same! After an hour of fierce fighting, the corners of the little baby's lips relaxed slightly, and the smile of victory became more and more obvious. In the office, Ou Muxuan leaned back on his chair in frustration. He was a computer expert and had never met an opponent before, but now, he lost to this intruder. Looking at the red heart bubbles displayed on the computer and the old-fashioned song "The First Experience of Love", Ou Muchuan felt a sense of frustration that he had never experienced before. At this time, another assistant, Gu Xin, walked in to report the situation. As soon as he entered the door, he saw their usually cold-hearted President Ou leaning back in his chair, listening to the song "If you want to leave me, please give me my photo back, and I will give it back to my mother..." Suddenly, the assistant was shocked. Their usually cold and ruthless president was actually listening to the song? And it’s still...still such an old-fashioned song? "...General...President..." Gu Xin blinked a pair of clear and innocent eyes, "You...are...so interested!" Ou Muxuan raised his head, glared fiercely at him with a cold look, and unplugged the computer, "I have something to say!" "That's right, President, the indestructible network security defense system you designed was breached five minutes ago!" Gu Xin said innocently. "What?!" Could it be that person again? "Have you found out who it is?" "So far... not yet..." "Where is the address? You should be able to find out the other party's address, right?" "Report to the president, a total of 9999 IPs are displayed, covering almost every corner of the world. We... can't do anything!" This was the first time they had encountered such a powerful hacker. Ou Muchuan waved his hand helplessly, "Fix the vulnerability as soon as possible." "Yes!" Looking at the computer, Ou Muchuan vowed to find this person out. However, the top priority was to save the files in the computer. When he reopened the computer, there were no missing files inside, but there was an additional software on the computer that he had never seen before. It seemed to be a chat software, and there was a document on the desktop. When he opened it, there was a sentence in it. "Mr. Ou, I don't mean any harm, I just have itchy hands. This chat software is the link between us. Don't delete it." Ou Muxuan moved the mouse to the software, hesitated for a moment, and did not delete it. It would be best if we can contact him sooner or later.
